# THORWallet

> THORWallet is a self-custody, multi-chain DeFi superapp for iOS, Android and Web. It offers native cross-chain swaps with no bridges or wrapped tokens, yield, multisig vaults, and a Swiss account with a global Mastercard. Tagline: "All chains. All yield. One app." Utility token: $TITN.

## Key facts

- Type: Non-custodial / self-custody crypto wallet — your keys never leave your device.
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Web (app.thorwallet.org).
- Swaps: Native cross-chain swaps across 20,000+ tokens, best-rate routing, no bridges, no wrapped tokens.
- Earn: Yield on stablecoins and crypto, liquidity pools, and $TITN staking.
- Multisig: Multi-device multisig vaults (e.g. 2-of-3, 3-of-4) for any chain and token.
- Card: Spend crypto via a global Mastercard in 175+ countries; 0% top-up fees, up to 2% cashback; Swiss IBAN & SEPA account.
- $TITN: Utility token. Stake to cut swap fees (down to 0.2%), earn up to ~70% USDC fee rebates, and unlock community perks. $TITN is a utility token, not an investment.
- Company: EMM Ventures AG, Zug, Switzerland.
